test_policy.notes: Test-optional for first-year students: applicants choose whether to submit SAT/ACT scores and are not penalized for not submitting; scores are never the sole or primary reason for a decision. The CDS (C8A) ticks 'not required for admission, but considered if submitted'. Scholarship and Honors College consideration do not require scores. OSU uses the best composite from one test date (no superscore). Admitted students who enroll are asked for official score reports for research only.

requirements.supplemental_essays: Personal statement plus one response to an available essay prompt on the application; no extra essay for test-optional applicants.
requirements.notes: International applicants are directed to OSU's international application (intlapps.oregonstate.edu, run with INTO OSU); OSU's first-year page also offers the Common App for Corvallis and OSU-Cascades without excluding international students, so check with International Admissions. The $65 fee is the domestic first-year fee on OSU's site and CDS C13; the international pages state no fee or waiver. Letters of recommendation are not required (only for appeals). Review is holistic: grades, course rigor, personal statement, essay, talents and achievements; the intended major is for advising only and is not considered in the decision, except that direct admission to Engineering needs pre-calculus or calculus. Course expectations: 4 years language arts, 3 math (4 encouraged), 3 social studies, 3 science, 2 second language. International applicants need a 3.0 GPA (IB 26, or IGCSE 5 subjects at 3.0 on the NCAA scale); lower English and GPA bars (2.5 GPA) apply to INTO OSU Pathway programs. Official transcripts may be requested after admission. The international pages publish no separate deadlines, so OSU's general fall 2027 dates are used.

deadlines.label: Early Action deadline, Corvallis campus (fall 2027)
deadlines.notes: Non-binding. Applicants with a complete file are notified by mid-December; some may be asked for mid-year transcripts first. Early Action and the priority round get the same holistic review. OSU's deadlines page lists this date for Corvallis campus applicants; the international pages publish no separate deadline.

deadlines.label: Priority application deadline, Corvallis campus (fall 2027)
deadlines.notes: Apply by this date for full consideration and the widest set of scholarships; later admission and scholarships are offered as space and funds allow. OSU's page lists no later final deadline for Corvallis first-year fall 2027 (August 25, 2027 is the final date for Ecampus online students only). The same page shows Corvallis applications for fall 2025 and fall 2026 as closed.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Test scores must be under two years old at the start term. OSU accepts instead: SAT Evidence-Based Reading and Writing 560, ACT English 21, IB Diploma Language A Language and Literature HL 5+, AP English Language or Literature 3+, two English composition courses at a U.S. university with C- or better (or one composition plus one speech course), IGCSE O or A Level English grade C or better (no provisional results), or INTO OSU Academic English Level 5. OSU's general English page also waives it after two or more full-time terms at 3.0+ in a rigorous program in the U.S., Australia, Canada, New Zealand, Nigeria or the UK. MyBest TOEFL and IELTS One Skill Retake are not accepted. Pathway programs take lower scores: 3-term pathway TOEFL 60, IELTS 5.5, PTEA 44, Duolingo 90; 4-term pathway TOEFL 50, IELTS 5.0, PTEA 41, Duolingo 75.

aid.notes: CDS H6 (2025-26): institutional need-based and non-need-based aid is available to degree-seeking nonresidents (361 recipients, average $8,996); H7 says nonresident first-year aid applicants must submit OSU's own financial aid form (no CSS Profile). OSU's international admissions pages describe only merit and regional awards for new international undergraduates (2025-26 pages, 2026-27 not confirmed): automatic regional awards of $2,000 to $16,000 a year for four years by country of residence (e.g. Europe, Latin America, Indonesia, Singapore $16,000; India $14,000; Vietnam and Africa $12,000; Southeast Asia, Hong Kong and Macau $8,000; Taiwan $2,000), the Provost's Scholarship for Excellence ($6,000 a year, GPA 3.5+, not combinable with regional awards) and a $2,000 Honorary Scholarship for Leadership (application). So need-based amounts for new international students are unconfirmed. INTO OSU program prices for 2025-26 (first-year, 3 terms): tuition and fees $41,110, housing and meals $15,840, insurance $2,880. OSU's financial aid page estimates the 2026-27 Corvallis nonresident undergraduate total at $65,013 for 3 terms (tuition and fees $42,459, food and housing $18,066, books, personal and transportation $4,488).

majors.notes: New freshmen need pre-calculus or calculus to be admitted directly into an Engineering degree. Students not ready for calculus can still be admitted to OSU but must get ready for Calculus before entering their Engineering major.
